bull.probability_evidence: Bull case: $5.5bn additional buyback authorised 2026-09-29 (~13% of the 43.1bn market cap) keeps the share count shrinking; RSI 35 after falling from the 572.56 swing high; advisor recruits from Merrill Lynch (Aug) and Wells Fargo (Sep) show the channel still attracts talent; Q3 results on 2026-10-29 are the near-term catalyst that could show attrition contained. Probability is cut from a 0.25 base case for the moderate bear macro tilt (research/AMP/2026-10-07-macro.md macro_tilt).

target_band.cite: Half the spread between the P/E-anchored target (629.0 = 5y-max P/E 15.2x x TTM EPS 41.38, EPS implied by the 12.0x P/E on the 496.61 close, factsheet Valuation/Price [RA,HI]) and the P/B-anchored implied price at the 5y-max P/B 9.9x on BVPS implied by the 6.9x P/B on the same close (712.5), relative to 629.0 = 6.64%. P/FCF excluded as an anchor: the evaluation rationale states AMP's P/FCF 'likely distorts' owner earnings via insurance balance-sheet flows (research/AMP/2026-10-07-evaluation.md Bear case); EV/EBITDA is [data unavailable] on the factsheet. Band (6.6%) is below the blended residual vol (22.5%, mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

base.probability_evidence: Base case: stable margins and continued steady buybacks return the P/E to its 5y median, the modal outcome absent either attrition resolution or escalation. Probability is cut from 0.50 for the moderate bear macro tilt tied to rising real yields (+0.71pp/3m) and widening HY spreads (+0.4pp/3m) (research/AMP/2026-10-07-macro.md macro_tilt).

target_band.cite: Half the spread between the P/E-anchored target (529.7 = 5y-median P/E 12.8x x TTM EPS 41.38, factsheet Valuation/Price [RA,HI]) and the P/B-anchored implied price at the 5y-median P/B 8.1x on the same BVPS (583.0), relative to 529.7 = 5.03%. P/FCF excluded as an anchor per the evaluation's distortion caveat (research/AMP/2026-10-07-evaluation.md Bear case); EV/EBITDA is [data unavailable]. Band (5.0%) is below the blended residual vol (22.5%, mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

bear.probability_evidence: Bear case: 2026-09-24 TheFly/Citywire report that AMP is offering bonuses and fee discounts to stem advisor attrition, consistent with five years of margin erosion (gross margin -5.5pp, net margin -6.7pp, factsheet IS); macro overlay's moderate bear tilt from rising real yields and widening HY spreads marks down AUM-linked fees further. Probability is raised from 0.25 for this tilt (research/AMP/2026-10-07-macro.md macro_tilt; research/AMP/2026-10-07.md Quality section).

target_band.cite: Half the spread between the P/E-anchored target (409.7 = 5y-min P/E 9.9x x TTM EPS 41.38, factsheet Valuation/Price [RA,HI]) and the P/B-anchored implied price at the 5y-min P/B 5.7x on the same BVPS (410.2), relative to 409.7 = 0.07% -- the two anchors converge in the bear case. P/FCF excluded per the evaluation's distortion caveat (research/AMP/2026-10-07-evaluation.md Bear case); EV/EBITDA is [data unavailable]. Band is well below the blended residual vol (22.5%, mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).

jumps.name: Quarterly earnings surprise
jumps.reason: AMP reports Q3 2026 results on 2026-10-29, the next scheduled catalyst inside the 12-month horizon; historical earnings weeks have produced moves well beyond a typical week in either direction (mc-inputs.json event_weeks, earnings_release entries).

annual_probability.cite: research/AMP/2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks earnings_release entries: 6 of the last 20 quarterly earnings weeks (2021-10-25 to 2026-07-20) moved >=5% in magnitude (2022-04-25 -5.21%, 2022-07-25 +10.14%, 2022-10-24 +16.91%, 2024-07-22 +6.97%, 2025-10-27 -5.51%, 2026-01-26 +6.16%), a 30% per-quarter base rate; annual probability of at least one such quarter = 1-(1-0.30)^4 = 0.76.
